page_review.title: Door
page_review.author: Nikolayy
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: One rusty single door leaf with upper glazed panels, lever and kick plate, beside a separate rectangular frame. Viewer exposes an animation. Local payload must establish closed pose, separable components, dimensions and hinges.

license_dependency_review: USDZ metadata records author Nikolayy, source URL and CC-BY-4.0; four 1024 px maps are embedded and inspection reports no external dependencies or separately stated map terms.
duplicate_remote_review: Inspect attempt 000001 fingerprint 65f1c3daae07eeaf289a70fb4c251f7509f1fc2ce44fed2d49a46eb1b8678dbd differs from all six accepted door fingerprints.
local_geometry_review: USDZ inspection exports two source meshes: components 0-8 belong to the animated leaf assembly, and components 9-10 to the fixed frame. Static zero pose is closed. Component 5 is the leaf, 1-4 are paired handle/plate surfaces, 0 is moving lock-edge plate, 6-8 are moving hinge barrels/cap, 9 is frame and 10 is fixed strike-side plate. Original source animation is not used for the common push task.
